top_signals.title: Air Force awards Boeing $131 billion ceiling contract for F-15 production, modernization
top_signals.summary: The Air Force has awarded Boeing a sole-source contract with a $131.23 billion ceiling to produce, modernize and sustain F-15 fighters.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.

top_signals.title: PaperCut warns of hackers using printer management software flaw in attacks
top_signals.summary: PaperCut released an emergency advisory on Thursday evening saying vulnerabilities in their print management software, PaperCut NG and MF, are under active exploitation.

top_signals.title: Bot Auto commits to U.S.-based remote assistance operators
top_signals.summary:
Bot Auto will staff its remote assistance operators exclusively with U.S. personnel, staking out ground a Senate investigation of robotaxi operators left wide open.
